summary: This directory provides a standardized abstraction layer for data access by defining generic CRUD repository interfaces and utilities for synchronizing entity states between application data and database records.
responsibilities: Defining generic interfaces for CRUD data operations
Deriving repository implementations from schema definitions
Calculating synchronization requirements between data sets
Validating field mappings between record definitions and database tables
relationships: Repository interfaces define the standard operations available for data access.
Schema definitions serve as the basis for generating specific repository types.
Entity diffing logic determines the necessary inserts, updates, and deletes based on schema constraints.
designDecisions: Use of generic interfaces for type-safe data access
Composition of repository capabilities through interface extension
Derivation of repository types from static schema structures
Separation of synchronization logic from repository interfaces
